title: Universal property of the sheaf of relative differentials
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\Omega^1_{X/S}$ be the sheaf of relative Kähler differentials with its universal derivation $\mathrm d:\mathcal O_X\to\Omega^1_{X/S}$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], so that on every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X$ mapping into an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ it is the sheaf associated to $\Omega_{A/R}$ with $\mathrm d$ induced by $\mathrm d:A\to\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. An *$S$-derivation* $D:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal F$ is a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups such that for every open $W\subseteq X$ and $a,b\in\mathcal O_X(W)$ one has $D(ab)=a\,D(b)+b\,D(a)$, and $D$ vanishes on the image $f^\sharp(r)|_W$ of every $r\in\mathcal O_S(V)$ whenever $W\subseteq f^{-1}(V)$; write $\operatorname{Der}_S(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal F)$ for the abelian group of these. Then $\mathrm d$ is an $S$-derivation, and composition with $\mathrm d$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\Omega^1_{X/S},\mathcal F)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Der}_S(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal F),\qquad \alpha\longmapsto\alpha\circ\mathrm d,$$
is an isomorphism of abelian groups, natural in $\mathcal F$ and compatible with restriction to open subschemes $W\subseteq X$.

source.place: Tag 01UR (lemma-universal-derivation-universal), for the affine-local description of $\Omega_{X/S}$ through Tag 01UT (lemma-differentials-affine) and Tag 01UO (lemma-affine-case-derivation: a derivation on an affine scheme is determined by, and extends from, its global sections); Tag 01US (lemma-differentials-restrict-open) for the compatibility with restriction.

proof.text: Use the proved source-library equivalence relativeDifferentialsHomEquiv of the differential sheaf [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. Its forward map is definitionally alpha ↦ relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp alpha.val, so Equiv.bijective proves the first conjunct for every module sheaf, without quasi-coherence. This equivalence comes from presheaf differential universality and the sheafification adjunction; no affine descent needs to be reconstructed.

Addition and zero of module-sheaf morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] are sectionwise: evaluating (alpha+beta)(da) gives alpha(da)+beta(da), and evaluating the zero map gives zero. The two derivations in the naturality clause have identical section maps h(alpha(da)); derivation extensionality proves their equality.

For an arbitrary open immersion j:U→X, the canonical relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso of [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] has inverse relativeDifferentialsToRestrict. The proved source-library formula relativeDifferentialsToRestrict_app_d sends d a over W to d((j.appIso W).inv a) over j(W). The component over W of the restricted alpha is the component over j(W) of alpha. Apply this component to that formula to obtain exactly the restriction identity. All isomorphisms and maps are the canonical ones in the original statement.

lean.statement: theorem relativeDifferentials_sheaf_universal_property {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules) : Function.Bijective (fun α : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ M ↦ f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp α.val) ∧ (∀ (α β : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ M) (W : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, W)), (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp (α + β).val).d (X := op W) a = (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp α.val).d (X := op W) a + (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp β.val).d (X := op W) a) ∧ (∀ (W : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, W)), (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp (0 : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ M).val).d (X := op W) a = 0) ∧ (∀ (N : X.Modules) (h : M ⟶ N) (α : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ M), f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp (α ≫ h).val = (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp α.val).postcomp h.val) ∧ (∀ (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (α : f.relativeDifferentials ⟶ M) (W : U.Opens) (a : Γ(U, W)), ((j ≫ f).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp ((f.relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso j).inv ≫ (Modules.restrictFunctor j).map α).val).d (X := op W) a = (f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.postcomp α.val).d (X := op (j ''ᵁ W)) ((j.appIso W).inv a))
lean.note: Uses the recorded canonical differential sheaf and universal derivation. The abelian-group assertion is expressed without a new group instance: bijectivity together with preservation of sectionwise addition and zero. Derivation' already stores additive section maps, Leibniz, restriction compatibility and base vanishing. Naturality and restriction are explicit final conjuncts.
